scripts.clean: rimraf app/.expo app/node_modules app/package-lock.json server/node_modules server/package-lock.json && cd app && npm cache clean --force
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run install-all && rimraf app/package-lock.json server/package-lock.json
scripts.format-all: cd app && npm run format-all && cd ../server && npm run format-all
scripts.install-all: cd app && npm i && cd ../server && npm i && cd .. && npm i
